flashcard_questions.q: The evaluation of food using the five senses: appearance (sight), aroma (smell), taste, texture (touch), and sound.
The distance food travels from where it is produced to where it is consumed, measured to assess the environmental impact of transportation.
Food that is permitted under Islamic law, including meat from animals slaughtered according to specific religious requirements with a prayer recited at the time of slaughter.

flashcard_questions.a: Food that meets the requirements of Jewish dietary law (kashrut), including the separation of meat and dairy, avoidance of pork and shellfish, and specific slaughter methods.

An autoimmune condition where the lining of the small intestine is damaged by gluten, a protein found in wheat, barley, and rye, causing symptoms such as bloating, diarrhoea, and malabsorption of nutrients.
